scope: Literal preference mentions in actual CF5 biographies, not causal classification or representative prevalence. Catalogs outside the preferences field are excluded.

rows.name: Adrian Santiago
preference_mentions: He likes soups that reheat well, especially vegetable soup, lentil soup, and a thick bean stew in cold weather.
A comfortable chair, a warm drink, and a low-key evening after a demanding day.

rows.name: Andrés Valdez
preference_mentions: He enjoys tacos with carne asada or grilled chicken, especially when the tortillas are warm and the salsa tastes fresh.
He likes a cold drink with a salty meal, but has been trying not to make sweetened drinks an everyday habit.

rows.name: Anthony James Holloway
preference_mentions: Making a large pot of chili, beans, or soup that can cover more than one meal.
Food that is greasy, cold, or left sitting too long.
A bowl of chili, beans, or soup appeals to him because it is inexpensive, comforting, and keeps well.
He will eat a salad but does not choose one automatically as his main meal.

rows.name: Avery Claire Maddox
preference_mentions: She likes the smell of onions cooking, warm bread, cinnamon, and food that has been in the oven long enough to make the house feel settled.
Warm showers and a reasonably steady bedtime after a busy day.

rows.name: Caleb Mercer
preference_mentions: Water after exercise and cold drinks that are not overly sweet.
He often declines salads with dressing already mixed in, but may tolerate a few separate ingredients.

rows.name: Clara Whitaker
preference_mentions: A warm bath when she is not already overtired.
A cold wipe against her skin can prompt a sharp protest during a change.

rows.name: Colton Hayes
preference_mentions: Vegetarian chili, bean burritos, lentil soup, and familiar meals that do not require specialty ingredients.

rows.name: Darius Coleman
preference_mentions: Fresh fruit and a prepared salad when both are reasonably priced and convenient.
Deli sandwiches, soup, or prepared meals on nights when work has run late.
A prepared salad or vegetables when he can get them without paying a large convenience premium.

rows.name: Diego Andrés Quintana
preference_mentions: A well-made breakfast taco, a crisp tostada, or a bowl of soup that tastes carefully seasoned rather than simply salty.

rows.name: Eleanor Whitcomb
preference_mentions: The smell of toasted bread and warm rice.

rows.name: Erin Michelle Dalton
preference_mentions: Mild seasoning, warm bread, baked potatoes, rice, soups, and simply prepared chicken or fish.

rows.name: Ethan Cole Rutledge
preference_mentions: Warm, filling food with familiar Southern flavors, such as beans, rice, greens, corn, and carefully seasoned vegetables.
He likes chili, vegetable soup, lentil stew, oatmeal, roasted potatoes, and greens made without animal fat.

rows.name: Gabriel Leon Sandoval
preference_mentions: He does not identify socializing as an interest, even though he can be warm and sociable in ordinary interactions.

rows.name: Gerald Thomas Lindquist
preference_mentions: A warm soup or casserole brought over by a family member on a cold day.
He will eat salad when it is offered, but does not seek it out as a meal.
He prefers food served warm and in moderate portions.
He enjoys a simple soup, especially chicken noodle or vegetable soup, in cold weather.
He does not identify cooking as an interest, though he can prepare toast, eggs, soup, or another basic meal when needed.

rows.name: Gloria Beatriz Valenzuela
preference_mentions: Mild chicken soup, arroz, beans, tortillas, baked chicken, and simple casseroles.
The smell of cinnamon, warm bread, and coffee, while preferring less pungent food aromas.
A modest, dependable car that starts on cold mornings.
Chicken soup is a favored meal after a difficult shift because it is comforting and reheats well.
She dislikes fussy plating and prefers food served warm in a familiar bowl or plate.

rows.name: Gregory Alan Whitfield
preference_mentions: He tends to favor cooked vegetables over raw salads, though he will eat a simple salad when it is convenient.
He likes a warm dessert such as cobbler or pie more than elaborate pastries.

rows.name: Hazel Marie Kessler
preference_mentions: Warm oatmeal and soft banana pieces, though appetite and acceptance vary with mood and timing.

rows.name: Jalen Rashad Montgomery
preference_mentions: He will eat vegetables when they are served in familiar preparations, though he does not seek out salads as a lifestyle statement.

rows.name: Janet Louise Harwood
preference_mentions: Prepared soup, a deli sandwich, rotisserie chicken, or a frozen meal when cooking feels like too much work.

Deli meals, prepared salads when they look fresh, microwaveable rice, canned or refrigerated soup, frozen entrees, sandwiches, fruit that requires little preparation, and takeout from familiar places.

rows.name: Kara Lindstrom
preference_mentions: She is comfortable adapting a casserole by using the vegetables, soup, or cheese already in the refrigerator.

rows.name: Lily Anderson
preference_mentions: A warm blanket and a quiet corner of the couch after school.

rows.name: Marco Antonio Salazar
preference_mentions: He will eat vegetables when they are part of a familiar meal, though he does not usually build meals around salads.

rows.name: Marjorie Keating
preference_mentions: She likes plain oatmeal, toast, eggs, baked chicken, mashed potatoes, vegetable soup, and simple pasta dishes.
She prefers food served warm and recognizable rather than elaborate presentation or tasting-menu portions.

rows.name: Martha Louise Pruitt
preference_mentions: Grits served warm and soft rather than dry or heavily seasoned.
A simple vegetable soup with a familiar broth and no hidden meat stock.
She checks whether soup or restaurant vegetables were cooked with meat broth when she remembers to ask.
She likes a mild vegetable soup on a cool day.

rows.name: Mateo Ortega
preference_mentions: Warm tortillas and the smell of food cooking when he knows a meal is nearly ready.
Cookies as an occasional treat, especially when they are still a little warm.
He values food that is warm and satisfying more than food presented as fashionable or unusually elaborate.

rows.name: Megan Claire Lawson
preference_mentions: She likes biscuits, cornbread, roasted potatoes, rice, green beans, and simple salads as familiar accompaniments.

rows.name: Melissa Dawn Hensley
preference_mentions: Warm cookies, cinnamon bread, and simple cakes made from dependable recipes.

rows.name: Molly Catherine Donahue
preference_mentions: Roast chicken, mashed potatoes, soup, and other unfussy meals that are easy to portion for a child.
A short walk with Penny when the weather is crisp but not bitterly cold.

rows.name: Nathaniel Scott Weber
preference_mentions: A warm drink and a calm half-hour after a shift before he starts household errands.

rows.name: Nolan Fischer
preference_mentions: Warm, plain foods that are easy to recognize, with sauce served separately when possible.
Seeing familiar relatives and being given time to warm up rather than immediately being asked to perform or talk.

rows.name: Owen Callahan
preference_mentions: Short messages that get to the point without sounding cold.
Cold water, especially after being outside in humid weather.

rows.name: Patricia Elena Villaseñor
preference_mentions: A properly browned tortilla and warm bread served straight from the pan or oven.

rows.name: Patrick Harlan
preference_mentions: People who are warm without demanding immediate intimacy.

rows.name: Rosa María Castañeda
preference_mentions: Chicken soup or a simple stew feels comforting after a difficult overnight shift.
She checks the weather before leaving and dislikes being caught far from home in cold rain.
Warm soup on a cold Milwaukee evening.

rows.name: Teresa Maribel Navarro
preference_mentions: Warm tortillas, rice, beans, and other foods associated with family meals, while recognizing that her own habits do not represent every Latino household.

rows.name: Wyatt Thomas Miller
preference_mentions: He dislikes cold wipes and may tense or fuss during a change.
He may pull away from a hat or jacket if he is warm or does not want it put on.

rows.name: Yolanda Reyes
preference_mentions: Making a pot of beans, rice, or soup that can cover more than one meal.
